title: IMDbPro Director Contact Scraper
description: Extract direct contact information from authorized IMDbPro discovery results. Paste any authorized IMDbPro Discover People URL to choose the profession, Star Meter range, credit filters, sorting, and other discovery filters.

startUrl.title: IMDbPro Start URL
startUrl.description: Paste the complete IMDbPro Discover People URL you want to scrape. You can change this before any run. The Actor will preserve the filters in this URL, such as profession, Star Meter range, credit year, sorting, and other discovery settings.

startPage.title: Start discovery page
startPage.description: Discovery page number where this run should begin. The Actor updates only the pageNumber parameter while preserving the other filters from the Start URL.

maxPages.title: Maximum discovery pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of discovery pages to process. Set to 0 to continue until the Actor run stops.

maxDirectors.title: Maximum profiles
maxDirectors.description: Maximum number of profiles to process in this run. Set to 0 for no artificial limit.
